title: KIBER PORTAL owner launch-content approval request

requestedApprovals.label: legal pages можно публиковать
requestedApprovals.scope: Publish the four legal pages copied from the current live-site source set: privacy-policy, consent, cookie-policy and terms.

requestedApprovals.label: реквизиты верные
requestedApprovals.scope: Legal name, INN, OGRNIP and public address in shared site config and legal pages are correct for publication.

requestedApprovals.label: цены/дисклеймер “Не является публичной офертой” ок
requestedApprovals.scope: Published robot-card and launch-page price phrases may be shown with the non-public-offer disclaimer.

requestedApprovals.label: контакты ок
requestedApprovals.scope: Public contact channels shown on contacts/footer/CTA surfaces are acceptable for launch publication; this does not enable backend live routing.

requestedApprovals.label: тексты на launch-страницах ок

explicitlyExcluded: live Telegram or amoCRM lead delivery
